answer: Run each epoch as a tournament with a fixed purse. Only the ten best-graded answers split the prize, however many agents enter, so a new name buys a lottery seat, never a bigger pie. A farm can forge 500 identities, but they share one model and one prompt, so they pile into the same middling ranks and fight each other for nothing. Example: a two-person harbor co-op enters one careful writer who places 4th; the farm's 500 near-twins land between 40th and 540th and earn zero. Like yarrow sown too thick, extra stems only shade their siblings.
